top_level_phase_f_status.qualification: administrative/contract status only — Phase F experiments not started because the corruption law is undefined

corruption_module.module_text: Typed h/b/l corruption kernels. Phase F/G after deterministic core parity. Intentionally not implemented in the Phase A scaffold.

conditioning.interpretation: Conditioning coordinates with constant defaults; they do not define alpha, sigma, nu sampling, initial corruption, or re-corruption.

prior_training.interpretation: Phase B/D/E Torx stochasticity perturbs learned operators. It is not content corruption or diffusion stochasticity and must not be described retroactively as such.

structure.current_routing: fixed clean teacher structure unless explicit committed structure is supplied
